professionalSummary: Software engineer with over two years of experience on a search indexing pipeline team, responsible for writing indexing jobs and schema changes, proving changes on a replay corpus, managing index rebuilds, addressing customer-facing support queries, and documenting boundaries for every change.
experienceHighlights: Authored and merged indexing jobs and schema changes for document and comment indexes under team engineering standards.
Proved every change on the replay corpus, attaching results to merge requests and maintaining a repository of replay results for the past two years.
Led nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with on‑call engineers, ensuring the pipeline lead’s go‑ahead was recorded each time.
Responded to customer‑facing support engineers’ questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, clearly marking ownership and referrals.
Documented written boundaries and hand‑over notes on every merge request, outlining what was not covered and what subsequent engineers need to know.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two merge requests with replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with pipeline lead go‑ahead, and one month of pipeline support channel activity, all referenced in the repository as verification.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team of a document collaboration company from 2022, writing the indexing jobs and the schema changes for the document and comment indexes under the team's engineering standard, with each change on a merge request in my name.

Work sample: two merge requests with their replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with the pipeline lead's go-ahead, and one month of the pipeline support channel, with the repository references as a verification trail.
Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository.
Work sample: two merge requests with their replay results and boundary notes...
Brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer; the rebuild go-ahead was the pipeline lead's each time, recorded on the rebuild checklist.
Work sample: one rebuild checklist with the pipeline lead's go-ahead...

Answered the customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, marking in each thread which answers were mine and which were referred to the pipeline lead.
Work sample: one month of the pipeline support channel...
Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.
